dedupe_keys.name: mpoinsli mapillary poi neighbourhood street level images new york city

description: MPOINSLI is a dataset of Mapillary street-view images of New York City that show part of a point of interest, such as a shop, school, health practice or museum, in their field of view, released on Zenodo as the outcome of a paper at the 2023 IEEE ICDEW workshop on neighbourhood analytics. The authors filtered all Mapillary images within 35 metres of POIs and kept those whose camera field-of-view triangle intersects the POI polygon, using 11,126 POIs from SafeGraph's Geometry and Places data with 875,592 Mapillary images; images are packaged by NAICS-style category (for example grocery stores, elementary and secondary schools, child day care, health practitioners, museums and historical sites) with a metadata archive. Coverage: New York City. Access: free download of large zip files from Zenodo (version V-0, February 2023). Licence: CC BY 4.0 on Zenodo. Caveats: POI geometry comes from a commercial source, Mapillary coverage is uneven. Simulation uses: training image models that recognise building uses and neighbourhood amenities for exposure and service models. Related records: Mapillary street-level imagery and NUS Global Streetscapes.
